interpretation.0_deg_q_equals_1: Thrust directly opposes total velocity — maximum braking
interpretation.180_deg_q_equals_minus_1: Thrust supports velocity — accelerates the stage
interpretation.90_deg_q_equals_0: Thrust is perpendicular to velocity — no first-order braking

projections.q_horizontal: Projection of thrust axis onto horizontal velocity component
projections.q_vertical: Projection of thrust axis onto vertical velocity component

where.u_T: Unit vector along the motor thrust axis (nose direction)
where.v_hat: Unit vector along the total velocity (normalized)

correction_rationale: The evidence only supports that the tested booster geometry, separation state, ballast distribution, motor set, and ignition windows are 3D-landing-infeasible. It does NOT prove that every 3+1 vehicle, every fixed aerodynamic topology, or every legal separation state is infeasible.

key_metrics_from_current_failure.interpretation: At apex, thrust axis is 28° from opposing velocity (good). By 15s, thrust axis is 83° from opposing velocity (nearly perpendicular). At impact, thrust axis is 89° from opposing velocity (useless for braking).
